description: Remove all visible burning-barrel props and their rendering; streetlights are usually OFF with independent bright flicker-ON pulses including real nearby illumination; stop always-on moving survivor fill light; add tuning for lamp ON frequency, chance, duration, range, brightness, idle glow and warmth; spawn rooftop firefights dynamically from many locations (incl distant 200m origins) aiming IN towards city with single 4-9 round or double 3-5 round bursts ~0.5s apart; add adjustable rain (0-1800 streaks, one draw call); replace debug modal with draggable collapsible overlay that still displays FPS when minimized; adapt warzone defaults to owner's supplied 10 Oct settings, preserve other tuning/gameplay. No full import or binary assets.
